latest_release.name: CADCraft v0.18.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Autosave: failures are shown, and a crash is recovered at the first relaunch by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2670
* A panic in the interface saves the work and reports it (E4) by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2671
* Add a security policy (E33) by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2672
* DWG reader and writer run in a child process (E7) by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2673
* constraints: find the next default parameter name in one pass by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2674
* Regions: bound the work of renesting loops after a boolean by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2680
* Extents: measure each block definition once per bulk extents pass by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2681
* constraints: share geometry preparation across an operation and budget spline rebuilds by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2677
* Autosave: keep every folder's lock, and don't let a failure hide or wait by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2676
* Multilines: find each segment's usable neighbour direction in linear time by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2679
* DXF: read up to 100 million group codes, or a set limit, without running out of memory silently (#1976) by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2683
* DXF: raise the group-code limit so large DWGs open (#1948) by @MrBeeboh in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1976
* constraints: evaluate a named expression without copying its text by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2675
* fonts: scan the Android and HarmonyOS system font directories by @qinshah in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2650
* Dynamic blocks: index kept objects once per listing; copy each value record once by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2678
* EXTEND: a polyline's arc end segment runs on round its circle by @Tyler-Chiriboga in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2656
* fix(io): a solid HATCH keeps its angle, scale and double flag by @euthiferreira in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2665
* FIND: a Find and Replace window, not only the command line by @r4x2t7 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2607
* EXPLODE: a block reference with different X and Y scales gives ellipses, not circles by @Tyler-Chiriboga in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2649
* Round-trip harness and corpus report: open, save, reopen and compare (#1937, E12) by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2685
* io: open → save → reopen round-trip harness with loss report, cadcraft-cli roundtrip, cargo xtask corpus (FF5) by @francescoBV in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1937
* fix(engine): merge another drawing's tables and blocks in linear time by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2689
* i18n(sv): translate 20 new strings by @kler in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2695
* MINSERT: a block reference repeated in rows and columns, as AutoCAD does by @2ez4gcx in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2698
* Drop missing files from the recent list when opening them fails by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2706
* fix(io): DXF import looks up linetype, style and entity layer names in a set by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2707
* fix(engine): look names up in an index in AUDIT, layer-state restore and CAL by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2712
* fix(io): an ACAD_TABLE with no rows or no columns reads as an empty table by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2708
* fix(io): sort each space once when a DXF has several SORTENTSTABLEs for it by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/s

detail.readme_excerpt:
CADCraft

Computer-aided design and drafting; an open-source, modern 2D and 3D CAD application, built in pure Rust.

A fast, open-source CAD workflow: the command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks and DXF drawings you already know. It runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and FreeBSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly.
By the ArtCraft team.
